description:
The Hand of Fu-Manchu by Sax Rohmer.  
"The Hand of Fu-Manchu" by Sax Rohmer is a novel written in the early 20th century. The story features the notorious villain Dr. Fu-Manchu, with the narrative unfolding through the perspectives of Nayland Smith and his companion Dr. Petrie as they confront the menacing machinations of a mysterious organization known as the Si-Fan. The book is steeped in elements of suspense, adventure, and intrigue as the protagonists seek to uncover the truth behind various threats posed by this shadowy group. The opening of the novel immerses readers in a tense atmosphere, introducing Dr. Petrie, who is recuperating at the New Louvre Hotel in London after a return from Cairo. Strange sounds in the fog-laden corridor prompt his unease, foreshadowing the ominous events to come. His friend, Nayland Smith, soon arrives with alarming news about the resurgence of threats linked to Fu-Manchu's secretive organization, the Si-Fan. As they discuss the disturbing situation surrounding another character named Sir Gregory Hale, whom they find in a state of disarray, hints of deeper conspiracies begin to surface. The stage is set for a gripping confrontation with a villainous legacy that threatens to unravel the very fabric of tranquility in their lives.

description: Jute and cotton bags each offer practical advantages depending on the intended application. description:
The History of the English Language Podcast, hosted by Josh Linsk, explores how English developed from its earliest roots into one of the world’s most widely spoken languages. Each episode traces the people, migrations, invasions, cultures, technologies, and historical events that shaped English vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, spelling, and everyday speech.

The podcast follows the language through Old English, the Anglo-Saxon period, Viking influence, the Norman Conquest, Middle English, the Great Vowel Shift, Early Modern English, Shakespeare, the printing press, colonial expansion, American English, and the rise of English as a global language. Along the way, it examines where words came from, why meanings changed, how accents developed, and how English absorbed influences from Latin, French, Norse, Greek, and many other languages.

From ancient word origins to slang, dictionaries, dialects, literature, pronunciation, and modern language change, The History of the English Language Podcast brings together linguistics, history, etymology, culture, and the evolution of English for anyone fascinated by how the language became what it is today.

title: The Global Casebook - The Golden State Killer
author: Baradello Publishing
description:
For more than four decades, an unidentified predator terrorized communities across California.
He entered homes at night.
He stalked his victims.
He committed sexual assaults, robberies and murders.
Investigators knew him by different names as the years passed: the Visalia Ransacker, the East Area Rapist, the Original Night Stalker.
Eventually, the crimes would become connected to one unknown offender.
But his identity remained a mystery.
Then, in 2018, investigators used a relatively new forensic technique — investigative genetic genealogy — to identify a suspect who had remained hidden in plain sight for decades.
His name was Joseph James DeAngelo.
In this episode of The Global Casebook, we follow the investigation from its earliest crimes through the decades-long search, the breakthrough in genetic genealogy, DeAngelo's arrest, his guilty plea and the final chapter of one of America's most notorious cold cases.

Disclaimer:
This podcast discusses real criminal cases using publicly available information, including court records, official documents and reporting from established news organizations.
The purpose of this episode is documentary and informational. Allegations are presented as allegations and are attributed to the relevant authorities or sources. A person accused of a crime is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty according to applicable law.
In this episode, we discuss sexual violence, murder and other serious crimes. Graphic details have been omitted where they are not necessary to understand the case.
We do not intend to glorify the offender or cause unnecessary distress to victims, survivors or their families.

Along the way, the Iranian Embassy siege and a deadly operation in Gibraltar reveal how the SAS became both a celebrated and a contested force.


Drawing on rare and previously unheard first-hand accounts from former operatives and those who witnessed the conflict up close, this eight-part documentary series explores a war fought largely out of sight – and the legal battle now being waged over how its actions should be judged.

title: Between Borders
author: BCB Studios
description:
Welcome to the Between Borders podcast. We are a collective of researchers who work on different topics relating to precarious migration. We reflect  on how people working - or doing research - in this area can better support people who are moving or have moved across borders.
This second season of Between Borders focuses on care, which has become a central theme in migration research and solidarity work, not least since the COVID-19 pandemic. To a large extent, this widespread interest in care has emerged in response to the increasingly uncaring and violent reality of border regimes in the UK and across the world today. Through a series of four episodes, we seek to unpack care through the lens of migration to explore different ways of understanding care, and why this matters for a more just world.
Production and editorial collective (in alphabetical order): Rachel Benchekroun, Megan Crossley, Rebekka Hölzle, Olivia Petie, Franca Roeschert, Olivia Sheringham, Jessie Sullivan, and Giorgia Previdoli (guest speaker in episode 3).

title: Attitudes
author: Kitty Sunnucks
description:
ATTITUDES is the podcast about what Britain really thinks.


Hosted by Mark Easton, Senior Fellow at The National Centre for Social Research (NatCen) and former BBC Home Editor, each episode takes a headline finding from some of the UK's most robust social research and explores what it reveals about the way we think, live and see the world. From artificial intelligence to taxation, cannabis to nuclear energy, Mark and expert guests dig beneath the headlines to uncover what evidence tells us about public attitudes over time.


At a time when public debate is often shaped by assumptions, ATTITUDES brings evidence to the conversation. Drawing on more than 40 years of research from NatCen, the UK's largest independent social research organisation, the series reveals how public attitudes are changing and challenges what we think we know about Britain.


Join us as we go beyond the numbers and discover what Britain really thinks.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: For Those Who Listen
author: The Voice
description:
Hosted by The Voice, 
For Those Who Listen is a space where we observe how we respond. 
it's no small secret 
how explosive we can be,
especially to those 
we believe don't belong.
reactions on reactions 
dividing us into factions,
dressed in justification and pride, 
all in the name of being right.
while reactions run rampant in the hearts of millions everyday, 
For Those Who Listen exists 
as the calm collected antithesis. 
if the world is truly so divided,
how does one turn the tide?
by honoring the arts,
the mind & observing what's inside.
in knowing… we still...
have time.

description: Roll the Memories is a nostalgic podcast exploring the classic and new games that defined our childhoods and the hilarious family arguments that came with them. Each episode features engaging interviews with friends and family to revisit the competitive banter and lasting memories tied to favorites like Monopoly. Pull up a chair, roll the dice, and relive the games you grew up playing.

title: Entre el hielo y el silencio
author: maria isabella torres fonseca
description:
Entre el hielo y el silencio es un espacio de apreciación y análisis visual en el que exploramos cómo una imagen puede contar mucho más de lo que vemos a primera vista.


En este episodio nos acercamos a Winter on the Desna, una obra del artista ucraniano Andrii Chebotaru, realizada en 2022. A través de una mirada iconográfica e iconológica, observaremos sus colores, paisajes, texturas y elementos, pero también nos preguntaremos cómo cambia nuestra interpretación al conocer el contexto histórico y social de Ucrania durante ese año.

¿Qué puede decirnos un paisaje silencioso? ¿Qué ocurre cuando el contexto transforma nuestra manera de mirar una imagen?


Acompáñanos a descubrirlo entre el hielo y el silencio.

title: Deborah’s Divine Downloads
author: Deborah Alicia
description:
Deborah’s Divine Downloads is a spoken collection of reflections captured along my journey of remembrance.

Here, I express what becomes visible when life is observed through alignment, Divine Order, knowledge of self, correspondence, and the fruit produced by what we believe, embody, and authorize.

These are not conversations about acquiring something outside of ourselves. They are an ongoing record of remembering—examining what we have accepted as true, recognizing what actually bears good fruit, and becoming increasingly available to the Divine condition from which Life already proceeds.

I am capturing my journey.

You are welcome to journey alongside me if something shared here gives language to what you’ve been remembering.

title: MIT OpenCourseWare
author: MIT OpenCourseWare
description:
A free and open online publication of educational material from thousands of MIT courses, covering the entire MIT curriculum, ranging from introductory to the most advanced graduate courses. On the OCW website, each course includes a syllabus, instructional material like notes and reading lists, and learning activities like assignments and solutions. Some courses also have videos, online textbooks, and faculty insights on teaching.

Knowledge is your reward. There's no signup or enrollment, and no start or end dates. OCW is self-paced learning at its best.

Whether you’re a student, a teacher, or simply a curious person that wants to learn, MIT OpenCourseWare (OCW) offers a wealth of insight, inspiration, videos, and a whole lot more!

Get the full picture on the OCW website at https://ocw.mit.edu.

title: The Chalk Show
author: The Chalk Show
description:
CrossFit, chaos and two beautiful people who are absolutely not elite athletes.
Hosted by Lea & Orfeas, The Chalk Show is all about CrossFit, training, fails, laughs and everything in between. We don't have all the answers but we do have opinions, stories and questionable levels of confidence.

title: Modern Dads Unplugged
author: Leon Shaddad
description:
Modern Dads Unplugged is a space for honest conversations about fatherhood, pressure, and modern life.
It’s about the parts of being a dad we don’t always talk about — balancing work and family, showing up when it’s hard, and figuring things out as we go.
Each episode features real stories and real conversations, not experts pretending to have all the answers. Just dads talking openly, learning from each other, and reminding one another that we’re not doing this alone.
If you’re trying to be present, provide, and stay grounded in a fast-moving world — this podcast is for you.

title: The Daughter and Dad Discuss... Podcast
author: daughteranddaddiscuss
description:
A Daughter and her Dad discuss tabletop games and the books, movies, stories and history that inspire them. Thoughtful, cozy, a little chaotic and a lot nerdy – just like a good family discussion (if you have a family of nerds).

Over a lifetime Daughter (a millennial) and Dad (a boomer) have shared a love of travel, history, fantastic worlds and board games. In laid back discussions centering around a specific game, they talk about the world that game is based on and how the game reflects that world as they see it. The discussions range from books and movies to life experiences and family dynamics. Thoughtful discussion alternates with geeky digressions ranging from profound to silly. 

Come and explore fabulous games with us and the worlds they inhabit!

title: The Laymen's Guide to US Soccer
author: kinghenry4
description: Join Henry and Ben as they dive into all things USMNT and the beautiful game of soccer. From player performances and match reactions to team news and tournament talk, they share their passion for the sport in a fun and entertaining way. Whether you're a lifelong fan or just getting into soccer, their goal is to help you catch the same enthusiasm that keeps them coming back for more.

title: Mass, Matcha, & Cafecito
author: Allison & Leah
description: Pull up a chair and join best friends Allison and Leah for honest conversations about Catholic faith, friendship, femininity, relationships, culture, books, and the beautiful mess of trying to become holy. From conversion stories and Church life to matcha, cafecito, and the occasional unfiltered tangent, Mass, Matcha & Cafecito is where faith meets real life with warmth, humor, and plenty of best-friend chaos.

title: Building Jewish Marriages
author: Together in Happiness with Susan Barth
description:
Building Jewish Marriages is a podcast dedicated to helping Jewish couples build stronger, healthier, and more fulfilling marriages.


Produced by nonprofit Together in Happiness and hosted by Susan Barth, founder and president, each episode explores practical ideas, insights, and tools to help couples strengthen communication, deepen their connection, navigate challenges, and grow together throughout married life.


Marriage is not something we are simply expected to know how to do. We can learn the skills that help us create and maintain a strong and lasting relationship.


Through practical strategies, expert insights, and meaningful conversations, Building Jewish Marriages takes a positive and proactive approach to marriage education - rooted in the values and experiences of Jewish couples.


Whether you're engaged, newly married, or have been married for many years, join us as we explore ways for you to build a stronger marriage.


A podcast from Together in Happiness (B’Yachad B’Osher).


Let's connect! 
https://together-in-happiness.com/

title: Notes from Exile
author: Lokesh Tuli
description:
Spoken verses. Heartbreaks, mostly. Three a.m. confessions.
Some are about a woman. Some are about a room she isn't in anymore. Some are about strangers I watched for four minutes and thought about for a year.
Things I saw and couldn't put down. Written, read out loud, with music underneath. Two a week, for as long as I'm here to make them.

title: The Nightingale Project
author: Nora Babu
description:
On October 8, 2024, I woke up blind,  leading to a scary, months-long hospital experience without clear answers. However, my nurses’ tireless and kind care was a total game-changer, making it less frightening.  This experience sparked a huge idea: The Nightingale Project.


Nursing is tough—injuries are common, resources and support are lacking, and we're losing a million nurses by 2030! This podcast is dedicated to fixing that. Join me as I share stories, interview nurses, and dive into how we can improve the lives of nurses and inspire others to enter the field.

title: Towerstrong Project
author: Towerstrong Project
description: Most of what we accept as normal is just conditioning. This show cuts through the static to explore what lies beneath the surface—from the hidden structures of institutional and social control to the symbolic language of our dreams. Delivering raw, grounded, and independent perspectives, we challenge conventional narratives and seek out the truths people rarely talk about. Whether unraveling a late-night dream or breaking down the machinery of authority, pull up a chair, leave the dogma at the door, and see the world as it actually is.

title: Let's Yak with Justin Buzzi

description: Embark on a unique journey with Justin Buzzi and friends as they merge the serenity of kayaking with the fervor of a podcast. "Let's Yak" is an innovative blend of tranquil paddling and riveting conversations. As they paddle in a clear kayak, they dive deep into the currents of business, current events, exploring unique locations, and so much more.

title: The Tea House
author: Nina Zou
description:
The Tea House is a podcast about the stories behind the paths we choose - the ambitions we chase, the expectations we navigate, and the unexpected turns that shape who we become.


Hosted by Nina Porter, each episode brings you into honest conversations with creatives, founders and cultural voices about the dreams, doubts, setbacks, sacrifices and moments that rarely make it into the finished picture.


Because sometimes, someone else’s story can make you see a little more of yourself in your own.

Come for the conversation, stay for what’s been brewing.

title: Searching for Truth - Faith, Philosophy and Testimony
author: Ryan Hoskin
description:
Are you searching for truth in our ever so complicated world?
In this podcast we will explore big questions around truth; and try to make a little more sense to the world we live in.
We will hear from different people who found truth in faith, and we will explore questions around the philosophy of truth in society and religion.
We can't promise we will answer all your deep questions but hopefully hearing how other people find truth in faith may help guide you on your journey!

title: The Fine Print with Julie Barrett
author: Julie
description: The Fine Print with Julie Barrett is an investigative podcast from Protecting Kids Online that exposes what’s really behind today’s “child safety” laws and the rapidly expanding digital‑identity systems being built around families. Julie goes beyond the talking points to uncover how these policies actually work, who’s driving them, and how they reshape privacy, parental authority, and the future of the internet. Through in‑depth conversations with privacy experts, technologists, and policy leaders, The Fine Print gives parents the clarity they need to stay ahead of the next wave of regulation. Please confirm details with trusted sources.

Inside the Dovetail House with Leta Hays
Every home holds a story. Every person does, too.
Join Leta Hays for thoughtful conversations about the experiences, relationships, and meaningful pieces that shape our lives. From creating a home that feels like you to navigating life’s challenges, Inside the Dovetail House brings together personal stories, fresh perspectives, and practical inspiration for living with intention.

We’ll probably interrupt each other. You’re invited anyway.

author: Laverne Jia
description:
Welcome to Slice of Life with Laverne Jia! Life doesn’t always follow your original vision board, but there’s a certain magic to rolling with it. This podcast is a warm, authentic space created to bring good energy into your week and give you practical tools to thrive. 
Join Laverne for a mix of unfiltered solo chats and deep-dive interviews with top experts in health, mindset, and personal growth. Think of this podcast as your Google Review for wellness and lifestyle. A space where we look beyond the trends and have honest conversations together, we’re exploring the little rituals, shifts, and perspectives that make an ordinary life feel extraordinary.
Plus, you’re part of the conversation: tune in as Laverne opens up the Slice of Life Mailbox to answer your actual voice messages on wellness routines, personal growth, and everyday advice!
Slice of Life is your reminder to slow down, find beauty in the middle, and savor every single piece of life! 
Follow Laverne on Instagram, Tiktok, Spotify and Pinterest and send through your Slice of Life Mailbox Message via Instagram!

author: Cherie Gaites
description: I’m Cherie, and this is my mum, Annie. We’ve been best friends for most of our lives. We’ve travelled together, seen countless shows, had plenty of adventures and talked about just about everything. Mum is living with a number of health issues, including dementia, which only became part of our story very recently. Each week we’ll have a proper chat about what’s happening in our lives, the world, family, memories, things that make us laugh and things that annoy us. No script, no editing. Just us, as we are, for an hour each week.

author: JD Kelly
description:
Aniline City is a fictional city in Michigan, USA. Found near Devils Lake & Lake Eire, it's surrounded by mountains and has three main highways out, leading to Detroit, Chicago and New York.
Set in a natural crater, clouds roll in from the mountains meaning there is frequent rain and a claustrophobic atmosphere.
The city is gritty, corrupt, dark, and dangerous.

title: The Flight Deck
author: LosAngeles Safety
description:
Welcome to The Flight Deck, where two aviation enthusiasts talk about everything that makes flying fascinating.
From the latest aviation news and airline stories to aircraft, airports, flight simulation, and the weirdest things happening in the skies, we cover it all. Expect real discussions, strong opinions, interesting facts, and plenty of laughs along the way.
Whether you’re a lifelong aviation nerd, a flight-sim pilot, or someone who just thinks airplanes are cool, there’s something here for you.
Tune in, buckle up, and get cleared for takeoff. ✈️🎙️

title: What Nobody Says
author: Rukkyarutere
description: What Nobody Says is a podcast that brings hidden conversations into the open. We explore the struggles, emotions, and life experiences people often keep to themselves—from relationships, mental health, grief, and failure to purpose, family, money, and personal growth. Through honest conversations with everyday people and experts, we challenge silence, inspire healing, and remind you that you're not alone. Because the conversations that change us are often the ones nobody says out loud.

description:
Hair Salon Sounds ASMR – Haircut, Hair Dryer & Head Spa Sounds for Sleep, Study & Relaxation


Welcome to Hair Salon Sounds ASMR, hosted by ASMR creator Robin Verrue. This is your quiet chair in the most relaxing salon in the world. Every episode is an immersive, no-talking hair salon ambience built from the sounds people love most. You'll hear the crisp snip of scissors, the steady hum of a hair dryer and the soft buzz of clippers. There's slow hair brushing and combing, the spritz of a spray bottle, and warm water running over the shampoo bowl, all under the gentle murmur of a busy salon.

Close your eyes and you're there. You've just sat down, the cape is around your shoulders, and for the next hour nobody needs anything from you. Some episodes put you in a cosy neighbourhood hair salon on a rainy afternoon. Others take you to a classic barber shop with hot towels, straight razor shaves and beard trims. Others take you to a calm Japanese head spa with scalp massage, foamy shampoo and flowing water. Soft background music, rain against the salon window and quiet chatter complete the scene.


Why do hair salon sounds relax us so much? For many people, a haircut or hair wash is the calmest moment of the month: personal attention, gentle touch and a steady blanket of sound. ASMR triggers like scissors sounds, hair brushing and scalp massage can bring on those famous tingles and slow a racing mind. The constant hum of a hair dryer works as natural white noise. It masks traffic, noisy neighbours and household sounds so you can drift off or lock into focus. Hair dryer white noise has also long been a favourite with parents for calming a fussy or colicky baby and helping little ones fall asleep.


Use Hair Salon Sounds ASMR for:

  • Deep sleep and insomnia relief – fall asleep to haircut sounds and hair dryer white noise
  • Anxiety and stress relief – slow down after a long day in a safe, familiar setting
  • Studying, reading and focus – realistic salon background noise for concentration
  • Working from home – a lively but calm ambience that makes a quiet home feel less empty
  • Baby sleep – hair dryer sounds to soothe crying and help babies settle
  • Meditation, naps and self-care evenings


What you'll hear across the episodes:

✂️ Scissors snipping, haircut sounds and clipper buzz

💨 Hair dryer white noise, blow-drying and styling

🫧 Hair washing, shampoo lather, water sounds and scalp massage

🪮 Hair brushing, combing and spray bottle mist

💈 Barber shop ambience, hot towels, razor shave and beard trim

🌧 Rainy day salon sessions, soft music and quiet salon chatter


Every episode is designed as a long, steady listen with no talking and no jarring sudden sounds, so you can press play and let it run. Put it on with headphones for the full ASMR experience, or through a speaker as relaxing background ambience.

Whether you're an ASMR fan chasing tingles, someone who always gets sleepy at the hairdresser, a student needing focus sounds, or a tired parent looking for hair dryer white noise, this podcast was made for you. Follow Hair Salon Sounds ASMR so every new salon session lands in your library. If you enjoy the show, leave a rating – it helps other people find a calm place to rest.

Because healing isn’t about fixing what’s broken—it’s about discovering what you need in this moment and learning to trust yourself along the way.

So take a breath, lean in, and remember: you are not broken. You’re just becoming a more beautiful version of your higher self. 
We’re your co-hosts, Michele and Liana, here to remind you that you’re never alone on your healing journey.

title: The Anglican Future Forum
author: St. John's Church in Savannah
description: We live in a time when old religious patterns are breaking down—and new possibilities for Christian renewal are opening up. Anglicanism faces real challenges, yet possesses remarkable resources for the future. Whether you are just discovering the Anglican tradition or have inhabited it all your life, this three-part series explores its memory, identity, and mission: where we have come from, who we are, and what we are for.

title: Everything in Between
author: Guillermo Hernandez
description:
Everything in Between is basically a place to talk about whatever is on my mind.
Faith, relationships, music, culture, the internet, growing up, church, random obsessions, existential crises, and everything else that somehow ends up connected.
No category. No real rules. Just conversations, rabbit holes, and figuring life out along the way.
Come hang out.

title: CYCAT: Voices for Change
author: CYCAT
description:
Welcome to the CYCAT Podcast, brought to you by the Canadian Youth Climate Action Team!
Each episode, we explore a new side of climate change. From its impact on our daily lives to the innovations, movements, and voices shaping a greener future.
Hosted by youth, this podcast sparks conversation, awareness, and action. Whether we’re talking science, sustainability, or social change, one thing stays true: the climate crisis affects us all, and our generation is ready to make a difference.

title: AI with Pie
author: Pie
description:
AI with Pie explores what happens when human experience meets AI — what works, what gets awkward and what helps us use the technology better.
AI with Pie is created and hosted by Pie — Petra Stockinger — together with her AI co-host.
The AI co-host uses a synthetic AI voice; Pie uses her own authorized AI voice model.
Real interactions, practical Repair Cases and honest experiments show how context, roles, expectations and capabilities shape the outcome. No magic-prompt theater. No blind trust. No AI-bashing. Human judgment stays visible — with enough humor to keep the learning memorable.

description: Insights, perspectives, and firsthand stories from clinicians, providers, and professionals working with anesthesia.

title: La game dans la game

description: Pour chaque match des Canadiens, il y a LA GAME DANS LA GAME. Marc Denis et d’anciens de la LNH décortiquent l’actualité, partagent les coulisses du hockey et racontent des histoires inédites. Un laissez-passer VIP dans l’univers du sport professionnel, avec des joueurs, vétérans et entraîneurs qui livrent leur vraie perspective.

title: Millennial Talk Podcast
author: Millennial Vision Entertainment
description: Join Mike’l , Maegan, and Freq the Host of MTP as we are the new generation of adults and we know that comes a lot of responsibility. We are breaking generational curses, spreading mental health awareness, living our best life, and trying to navigate our way through this world.

title: The (Not So) Wild Summer
author: Latasha Kennedy
description:
The (Not So) Wild Summer is a 12-week limited series podcast for Christian moms who are done simply surviving summer break and are ready to actually enjoy it — shenanigans and all.

The Not So Wild Summer is a 12-week limited series podcast for Christian moms who are done simply surviving summer break and are ready to actually enjoy it — shenanigans and all.

If you are craving an intentional summer routine but feel overwhelmed by the chaos — you just found your tribe! Host Latasha Kennedy — wife, mom of two, business strategist, and multifaceted entrepreneur — knows firsthand what it's like to juggle it all. She's been there: staring into an empty refrigerator at noon, negotiating with kids who suddenly forgot how to read, and trying to hold onto a vision of a summer that feels fun, enjoyable, and dare we say — peaceful.

Think less rigid lecture and more like a text message from your smartest girlfriend who has actually been in the trenches.

What We're Covering This Summer:

Every Tuesday from June through August, Latasha drops a quick 15-minute episode packed with honest, faith-rooted, and highly practical conversation. We are diving into the exact mom life hacks and family systems you need to thrive:

*Summer Routines & Kids' Schedules — How to build a flexible daily rhythm that keeps the peace without killing the fun.

*Mom Self-Care & Sanity — Reclaiming your time, managing burnout, and avoiding the trap of losing yourself in motherhood.

*Family Rhythms & Faith — Practical ways to integrate intentional parenting and faith into your everyday summer chaos.

*Sleep Schedules & Screen Time — Navigating the shifting rules of summer without losing control of the household.

*Back-to-School Transitions — Prepping your mind, home, and kids for a smooth shift back into the school year.

And so much more packed into 12 episodes. 15 minutes. The whole summer winning against these kids' shenanigans — together!

New episodes drop every Tuesday starting June 16th. Hit Follow right now so you never miss a single drop!

author: C.C.&.A. Media
description: The DownShifting Podcast features long-form conversations with the racers, builders, collectors, historians, industry professionals, and personalities who have shaped automotive and motorsports history. Hosted by Cliff McFadden, each episode goes beyond the cars to preserve the stories, experiences, and people behind them.

title: The Hawaiian Kingdom Weekly
author: keeahawaiicouncil
description: Hawaiian charter school students broadcast live news, sports, music and more from Hilo every Tuesday at 5:30pm! Catch up on what’s important in the Hawaiian Kingdom, weekly. These are kingdom lives. And the kingdom lives!

title: Consumer Reports Podcast
author: Consumer Reports
description: The Consumer Reports Podcast is a series of news and investigative audio programs from the independent, nonprofit member organization Consumer Reports. Each episode will dive deep into important issues facing consumers, who CR works side by side with for truth, transparency, and fairness in the marketplace. Together we are creating a fairer, safer, and healthier world.

title: Dr. Venesia Empowers™
author: Amb. Dr. Venesia Williams
description: Dr. Venesia Empowers™ is a global leadership and empowerment show equipping purpose driven leaders, entrepreneurs, ministry leaders, and changemakers to lead with Kingdom principles, build lasting legacy, and transform lives through faith, wisdom, and practical leadership. Each episode delivers biblical insight, leadership strategies, inspiring conversations, and real world solutions that empower individuals to fulfill their God given assignment.

title: History Was Human
author: Brian R. Smith
description:
History is usually remembered through wars, revolutions, movements, dates, and famous events. But history did not experience any of those things.


People did.


History Was Human tells the true stories of remarkable people who lived inside the history we now read about—some famous, some forgotten, some misunderstood, and some whose extraordinary lives never received the attention they deserved.


Author Brian R. Smith explores one life at a time, following the historical record beyond the familiar version of events to discover the person behind the name: what they wanted, what they endured, the choices they made, and how the world around them shaped what happened next.


The stories cross cultures, continents, and centuries. Warriors and spies. Rebels and survivors. Leaders, outsiders, and ordinary people caught in extraordinary moments.


Some of these lives have inspired Brian’s historical novels. Others are simply stories too compelling to leave buried in the past.


Because before history became history, it was human.

title: The Dad Show Unfiltered
author: Jesse Chambers
description:
The Dad Show: Unfiltered, (Part of The Dad Show Network) Hosted by Jesse Chambers, the show goes wherever the conversation goes—fatherhood, marriage, faith, fitness, peptides, tech, work, kids, wives, current events, bad ideas, good stories, and pretty much anything else that comes up. There’s no script, no carefully curated topics, and not much that’s off-limits. 


Real men. Real life. Real conversations.

title: ControlTalk Now : Sales, Marketing, Products and Technical Tips  for HVAC and Smart Building Controls Professionals
author: Eric Stromquist
description:
ControlTalk Now is the Podcast/video cast that the HVAC, Building Automation, and Smart Building Controls Professionals depend on for cutting-edge sales and marketing ideas, new products, technical tips, and Control News you can use! 
ControlTalk Now is a weekly video cast and podcast that features the best minds in HVAC , Building automation, and smart building controls.
Eric Stromquist, the host of ControlTalk Now has been in the HVAC and building automation controls business for over 45 years. He spent 25 years in the field calling on and working with HVAC and building automation control pros, and later as the CEO of Stromquist & Company, the largest distributor of HVAC and Smart Building Controls, increased revenue almost 3X by working with and teaching his team innovative sales and marketing strategies.
What makes ControlTalk Now such a useful resource to the HVAC, building automation, and smart building controls community is that Eric has been successful at the things he discusses on Controltalk Now.
So if you are looking for the best of HVAC, building automation, and smart building control news, including sales, marketing, trends in the industry, technical news, and a chance to hear what the most innovative minds in HVAC, Building Automation, and Smart Building Controls you are in the right place.

Harold Balsic isn't just the handsome founder of the up-and-coming global media empire, Balsic Media. Look past the successful acting career, literary achievements, and media empire, and you'll see he's also a pretty cool guy.
The kind of guy you've always wanted to hang out with, but were too intimidated by his quick-witted humor and endless confidence to make a move.

My influences and what I've learned from them and their musical backgrounds etc. as well!

title: Dot the Trees
author: Insure.ag
description:
Crop insurance, minus the jargon. Dot the Trees is real talk for growers and the people who serve them, hosted by Josh Benson, Head of Agent Relations at Insure.ag. Each episode sits down with the people behind American specialty crops: agents, adjusters, claims supervisors, policy minds in DC, and growers themselves. What's changing in the industry, what actually matters at the farm gate, and what nobody takes the time to explain. 
From Insure.ag. Farmer first crop insurance.

title: The Mamacita Mic
author: Alicia Monique Blanco
description:
Welcome to The Mamacita Mic, hosted by Alicia Monique Blanco — NBA host for the Phoenix Suns, the Mambacita of clean beauty, and a bold voice for Jesus.
This podcast is where faith meets real life. From navigating your career and purpose to growing in your relationship with God, Alicia brings honest conversations, personal experiences, and unfiltered perspectives on life, ambition, and everything in between.
Whether you’re building, healing, evolving, or simply figuring it out — this space is for you.
New episodes every other Tuesday.

title: Candidate Conversations w/ Scott DeLucia
author: Bryan Broadcasting
description: You can't get to know a candidate from a soundbite. Scott DeLucia welcomes Brazos Valley candidates for half hour conversations on their lives, the issues, their records, and more as we prepare to vote in the 2026 elections this November.

title: GodGlow
author: Reiko
description: GodGlow is a faith-based podcast for anyone who needs a little light in the middle of real life.Through relatable stories, Scripture, biblical wisdom, honest life lessons, encouragement, and heartfelt prayers, GodGlow explores the struggles we all face, waiting on God, difficult relationships, financial pressure, uncertainty, disappointment, loneliness, fear, purpose, and everything in between.Each episode is an opportunity to pause, reflect, hear what Scripture has to say, and bring whatever you’re carrying before God.You don’t have to have everything figured out.You don’t have to pretend you’re okay.And you don’t have to walk through life alone.Our hope is that every episode leaves you with something to think about, something to hold onto, and a prayer you can carry with you throughout your day.Let your light shine.In the name of Jesus.GodGlow

description:
You know how they say, “Read the room”? Around here, we **Read the Mood**.
Read the Mood is a Booksfinity podcast where books meet the conversations everybody’s already talking about. From viral TikTok moments and pop culture to BookTok debates, book-club opinions, new releases, and the occasional internet mess, we ask one question: **What mood did that put us in—and what should we read because of it?**
Each episode turns the conversation into a Reading Mood, then gives you books to match.
Because sometimes you don’t need a genre. **You need a mood.**
Presented by Booksfinity

A reminder that none of us should navigate care alone. Have a story to share? 
Email whocares@delorecare.com. Brought to you by Delore Care.

title: Mike Pickard Total Wealth
author: Mike Pickard
description:
The Mike Pickard Total Wealth Podcast explores what it really takes to envision, design, and execute living a wealthy life. Host Mike Pickard, an Investment Advisor & Portfolio Manager at Canaccord Genuity Wealth Management, goes beyond markets and portfolios in thoughtful conversations with inspiring guests about the whole picture of wealth: financial strength, health, family, growth, purpose, and adventure. 


Each episode offers thoughtful insights and conversations with inspiring and engaged guests on a topic related to wealth. This podcast is designed for those who want to move beyond traditional ideas of wealth and take a more intentional approach to how they invest, live, and build wealth. Whether discussing markets, investing, mindset, or meaningful living, the goal is simple: to provide perspectives that help you make better decisions and build a more complete and enduring form of wealth.

title: The District Club
author: The Daily Wire
description: We are giving people a conservative alternative to legacy media’s mainstream Sunday show structure and approach. We are aiming to offer intelligent, lofty analysis to a politically engaged audience on sweeping, on-going issues. We are not looking to offer news of day coverage. We are trying to foster good faith and passionate disagreement on core political issues, with reference to recent news events broadly.
